# Plug-in ABI and Versioning Requirements Quality Checklist: Versioned Plug-in ABIs (spec 037)

**Purpose**: Are the MAJOR/MINOR rules, unversioned-plug-in handling and table-size rules complete, consistent and measurable?
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/ read for cross-checks)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## MAJOR / MINOR handling

- [x] CHK001 Is the set of "MAJORs the host supports" per family stated in one normative place (dlo/implicit/shadeop = host's own, display = 1 and 2)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK002 Is the behaviour for a newer-MINOR plug-in defined for what the plug-in may *not* assume (host-provided structs/features absent in an older host)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Is the host-to-plug-in direction covered: do structs the host hands to a plug-in (host info, display info) carry a size/version the plug-in must honour, as the plug-in-to-host table does? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK004 Do FR-003 ("an equal-or-older MINOR loads silently") and the size rule in US6-1 ("rejects a smaller table") agree when the host's table grows in a later MINOR and an older-MINOR plug-in supplies the smaller table? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003, §US6-1/FR-010]
- [x] CHK005 Is the required table size defined per declared MINOR (not only "the fields the host knows")? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK006 Is there a stated rule for how the version query symbol and the table's own `abiVersion` relate (which is authoritative, what happens if their MAJORs differ)? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 Is the diagnostic content (file, interface, both versions, remedy) specified as text/fields precisely enough to assert on, including the "raw value" printed for garbage? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, §SC-001, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 Does "the plug-in's code is never entered" (SC-001) account for module static initialisers that run at load time, before any version check can happen? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK009 Is PATCH defined as informational only (never gating), and are the 8-bit MINOR/PATCH limits and overflow behaviour stated? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions "Encoding"]
- [x] CHK010 Is MAJOR 0 handling (rejected unless host MAJOR is 0) consistent with the host's actual supported set for every family? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is the render outcome after a rejection ("continues without that plug-in or fails as for a missing plug-in") specified per family, not just generically? [Clarity, Spec §US1-1]

## Unversioned plug-ins

- [x] CHK012 Do FR-006/FR-007 ("a plug-in that exports no version symbol ... with one warning") and FR-009 ("absent symbol is normal, no warning" for DynamicLoad) agree, with the exception stated in FR-006/007 and SC-002? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007, §FR-009, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK013 Is "once per module per run" defined (process, RiBegin..RiEnd session, or frame)? The adapter contract says "per process"; the spec says "per run". [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK014 Is "once per module" defined when a module is unloaded and reloaded within a run (display modules per frame, dynamic-load per frame)? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases "loaded twice"]
- [x] CHK015 Is the single release constant (1.2.0) and the wording of the warning specified, and is it stated that it is the only place the release name appears in code? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK016 Is the 1.1.0/1.2.0 release pairing consistent with the tree's current project version (1.0.0 in CMakeLists.txt) and flagged as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK017 Is it clear that no 037 requirement depends on the later rejection release or the merge? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §Assumptions "Legacy sunset"]

## Table sizes and the shared convention

- [x] CHK018 Is it stated which of the four existing families use the function-table convention and which stay symbol-based ("where their legacy shape allows" is not enumerated)? [Ambiguity, Spec §US6 Why/FR-010]
- [x] CHK019 Are ownership rules for every pointer crossing the boundary stated in the spec requirements, not only in contracts (who allocates/frees, validity period)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK020 Is the status/error code set named or enumerated, and is its relation to the "false return" wording of FR-017 clear? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK021 Is "rejected without reading past the table" measurable for a table smaller than the header itself? [Measurability, Spec §US6-2, §SC-010]
- [x] CHK022 Is C++ convenience header equivalence ("same table a hand-written C plug-in would") defined by an objective criterion (layout, field values)? [Measurability, Spec §US6-3]
- [x] CHK023 Are version histories required for dlo, implicit, DynamicLoad and shadeop (with 1.1.0 optional per-thread entry points listed as MINOR), and is each history's required content stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK024 Does FR-005's "same signature" requirement and the 1.0.0 "binary-compatible" claim agree with US2-2 ("in-tree plug-ins compile unchanged apart from one line") given `argv` type and `const char *` field changes? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005, §US2-2; contracts/shadeop.md §1]
